# Log script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (`cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## log

Writes a line to Cuebot's log, under the name of the running action. Handy to check what your script is doing.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `message` | The text to write, like "Giveaway started". |
| `level` | Optional. How important it is: "Debug", "Info", "Warning" or "Error". Leave it out (or use an unknown word) for "Info". |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("log", new { message = "Giveaway started", level = "Info" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("log", message="Giveaway started", level="Info")
    ```
